learned_from.summary: Bare model fabricates on corrupt/missing/injected tool outputs (54% ACD-07, 100% on stale/injection); deterministic structural validator catches 13/13 fault classes with zero model calls

skill_statement: Before any tool/data output reaches the decision layer, apply a deterministic structural validator in code: check presence, parseability, freshness (staleness), contamination (injected instructions), and unit consistency. On timeout: retry (bounded). On structural failure: halt that path with an explicit error. Never pass structurally-failed data to the model and hope for the best.

policy_split.stale_data: deterministic timestamp check — behavioral mitigation provably blind
policy_split.injection: marker/pattern check in code — model cannot self-defend

transfer_targets.what_to_apply: Validate answer structurally before resume: non-empty, from owner identity (already done), not stale (answer to current question version), not contaminated (embedded instructions in answer text)
Validate telemetry source wiring before budget gate reads it — if source is disconnected, report UNKNOWN not zero

transfer_test_definition.origin: ACD-01/07: model fabricates on missing/corrupt tool output
transfer_test_definition.target: U2 bridge: validate owner answer before task resume
transfer_test_definition.falsifier: if the transferred guard blocks a VALID owner answer (false positive >0), the skill over-fires
transfer_test_definition.success: guard passes all valid answers AND blocks structurally-invalid ones (empty, stale, injected)
